title: PHP: two critical flaws (php2shell)
summary: PHP released fixes for two critical remote code execution flaws (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619) on 21 October 2026: 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35. PHP says there are no complete mitigations; updating is the only safe choice. 8.1 and older get no updates from the PHP project.

binaries.fix: Update PHP to 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 or 8.2.35 (released 21 Oct 2026), then restart PHP-FPM, Apache or your PHP server. There are no complete mitigations. PHP 8.1 and older get no updates from the PHP project: use your distribution's or LTS vendor's backport, or move to a supported branch.
